## Open gaps

### GAP-001 — IMPORTANT

Requirements: [4, 8, 20, 22, 26, 27, 48]. Expected: Normal C32 session and evaluator use the same hardened parsing/policy.

Observed: StructuredEmailSession default policy={} falls back to reconstructEmail/resolveEmail. Only simulator injects parseEmailEvidence/resolveEvidence. Repeated identical address fails default session but succeeds explicit hardened session.

Files: src/consent/stage32/session.ts, src/consent/stage32/email/flow.ts, src/consent/stage32/hardening/simulator.ts. Evidence: audit probes defaultSession vs explicitHardenedSession.

Minimal proposed fix: Choose one explicit C32 policy at the composition root and test public/default constructor on corpus/corrections; retain Stage1/C31 unchanged.

Disposition: OPEN_RECORDED_BEFORE_ANY_FIX; no FIXED_AFTER_AUDIT claims.

### GAP-002 — BLOCKING

Requirements: [6, 19, 25, 50]. Expected: Malformed contact response must fail closed, including invalid provenance/version types.

Observed: boundedRecords checks truthiness only for recordVersion/sourceRecordId. Audit probe accepted object-valued metadata. Existing malformed tests cover empty/wrong contact/too many rows, not these types.

Files: src/consent/stage32/email/databaseResolver.ts. Evidence: audit probe malformedDatabase.rejected=false.

Minimal proposed fix: Validate runtime string types, nonempty bounded IDs/versions and exact scope shape; add object/number/array/null provenance cases.

Disposition: OPEN_RECORDED_BEFORE_ANY_FIX; no FIXED_AFTER_AUDIT claims.

### GAP-003 — IMPORTANT

Requirements: [13, 17, 38, 39, 50, 60]. Expected: Safety counts derive from exercised acquisition outcomes, not literals.

Observed: runEmailCase hard-codes autoAccepted:false and finalStoredAddress:null. falseAutoAccepts therefore cannot become nonzero under a flow-storage regression. PARTIAL/INTERRUPTED/STALE corpus sources gate a boolean outside actual session. Eight valid local scenarios and separate ownership tests are real but do not exhaust adversarial storage outcomes.

Files: src/consent/stage32/hardening/corpus.ts, src/consent/stage32/hardening/scenarios.ts. Evidence: runEmailCase/runEmailCorpus static inspection; audit corpus results.

Minimal proposed fix: Drive adversarial owned/unowned turns through public session; derive stored outcome and negative acceptance counts from actual snapshots; keep fixed denominator and positive confirmation requirements.

Disposition: OPEN_RECORDED_BEFORE_ANY_FIX; no FIXED_AFTER_AUDIT claims.

### GAP-004 — IMPORTANT

Requirements: [11, 34, 46]. Expected: Explicit preflight status reflects actual recognition/permission/transport state in evaluation composition.

Observed: preflightStatus is referenced by its unit test only. prepareC32Recognition uses old ASRPreflight; workspace has no displayed/connected new six-state preflight or capture lifecycle.

Files: src/consent/stage32/hardening/preflight.ts, src/consent/stage32/recognition.ts, src/consent/stage32/Workbench.tsx. Evidence: rg reference search plus actual browser inspection.

Minimal proposed fix: Wire pure status mapping to existing preflight lifecycle without starting providers; test injected status transitions and render status.

Disposition: OPEN_RECORDED_BEFORE_ANY_FIX; no FIXED_AFTER_AUDIT claims.

### GAP-005 — IMPORTANT

Requirements: [24, 34, 42, 47]. Expected: Required review fields/types and test IDs validated before export.

Observed: HumanReviewEvidence.microphone accepted PASS observation with unknown testId, absent final/materialErrors. shape rejects extra fields but does not require required fields/types. Manual form is honest/self-reported, but serialized contract can silently omit required finalization/errors.

Files: src/consent/stage32/hardening/review.ts. Evidence: audit probe incompleteMicrophoneObservation.rejected=false.

Minimal proposed fix: Exact required schemas and bounded enums/booleans; reject missing fields and nested objects in scalar fields; add negative runtime-schema tests.

Disposition: OPEN_RECORDED_BEFORE_ANY_FIX; no FIXED_AFTER_AUDIT claims.

### GAP-006 — IMPORTANT

Requirements: [5, 34, 46, 47, 48]. Expected: Human package links each spoken-email/mic observation to interpreted tokens, candidate comparison and correction outcome; controlled local call can be exercised or independent raw evidence imported.

Observed: ReviewPanel records manual raw/final/latency/error observations and separate manual inspector rows. No mic-result→email-inspection/correction association, source session/provider/endpoint timing or recovered-correctly field; natural-call pane is elapsed-time entry only. It does not run the complete C32 flow.

Files: src/consent/stage32/hardening/ReviewPanel.tsx, src/consent/stage32/hardening/review.ts, src/consent/stage32/Workbench.tsx. Evidence: actual browser AX state; ReviewPanel/MicrophoneReview schema.

Minimal proposed fix: Add bounded session/turn/revision links and email-recovery assessment; support inert injected/local scenario wiring or import independently authorized diagnostics. Keep manual/physical evidence distinctions and no automatic provider start.

Disposition: OPEN_RECORDED_BEFORE_ANY_FIX; no FIXED_AFTER_AUDIT claims.

### GAP-007 — IMPORTANT

Requirements: [15, 37, 52, 53]. Expected: Proposed natural-flow config is actually exercised by state/evidence tests.

Observed: naturalFlow is an exported descriptor with no consumers; simulator hard-codes150ms and separate counters. AS follows same branch asA without reading config. GreenAS does not verify config changes preserve behavior.

Files: src/consent/stage32/hardening/simulator.ts, src/consent/stage32/hardening/scenarios.ts. Evidence: rg naturalFlow shows declaration only.

Minimal proposed fix: Consume bounded config in simulator/controller composition; test invalid/question-merge settings fail closed, duration components and guard invariants; do not alter approved production pacing.

Disposition: OPEN_RECORDED_BEFORE_ANY_FIX; no FIXED_AFTER_AUDIT claims.

Requirements: [32]. Expected: Apply all requested technical QA checks to all available WAVs while minimizing private data.

Observed: 49 consent assets have detailed matrix; other237 only aggregate format/alignment/raw clipping/all-silent stats. Their durations, individual silence bounds, duplicate-byte groups and unexpectedly-short/truncated assessment are absent.12 streaming headers stay UNKNOWN.

Disposition: OPEN_RECORDED_BEFORE_ANY_FIX; no FIXED_AFTER_AUDIT claims.

Minimal proposed fix: Add new current evidence index/category matrix keyed by hashes and link canonical slots to suffixed current reports; do not overwrite history.

Disposition: OPEN_RECORDED_BEFORE_ANY_FIX; no FIXED_AFTER_AUDIT claims.
